observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage or studio with a light wooden floor and white backdrop curtains, likely a dance convention or showcase event.
observation.dancers: One man and one woman initially, then the woman dances solo as the man steps aside; mixed gender, adults.
observation.formation_and_space: Solo and duo performing side-by-side or solo in place, moving within a small area on stage without traveling far.
observation.posture: Upright torso with soft, slightly bent knees, weight shifting actively between feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic quick steps, side-to-side weight shifts, toe taps, and small kicks coordinated with the beat; exact foot articulation is partially obscured by camera angle and low resolution.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move casually or hold posture frames, one hand sometimes resting on the hip or snapping fingers; the man holds a microphone and a water bottle.
observation.hips_and_torso: Natural hip action and slight torso sway responding to the weight shifts and rhythm.
observation.partnering: None; dancers perform solo routines side by side without physical contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low to medium level, no major jumps or floor work; occasional pivots and turns on heels or balls of feet.
observation.costume_and_props: Woman wears a dark short-sleeved romper with buttons and high-heeled dance shoes; man wears a red button-down shirt over a black shirt, black trousers, and dress shoes, holding a microphone and water bottle.
observation.cannot_infer: Low-resolution framing obscures precise foot placements, ankle actions, and exact weight transfer details.

signature_moments.what: Side-to-side stepping with alternate knee lifts and rhythmic arm swings.
Quick stepping with alternating foot taps and one arm raised pointing outward.
Solo female dancer performs rapid weight changes with expressive arm styling and hip movement.
